name: NTR: Her Lie
source:
Something is wrong.

Your girlfriend Lena has been distant. Longer hours. Short answers. A growing silence between you.

[From [url=https://deviantdreams.itch.io/ntr-herlie]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
事情不对劲。

女友莱娜最近和你疏远了。工作时间越来越长。回答越来越短。两个人之间的沉默越来越久。

［摘自[url=https://deviantdreams.itch.io/ntr-herlie]Itch.io[/url]］
